description: Anonymous public Soomgo reads, public profile readers, and local request preparation are tracked separately from authenticated owner/account reads. Naver UI sign-in and direct owner/list reads succeeded on 140.228; the dated production CLI/DPAPI receipts are being finalized. Business request, quote, message, reservation, and payment writes remain disabled.

capabilities.title: Read public Soomgo top categories from the current first-party client contract
capabilities.note: Contract provenance is first_party_bundle_contract with a pinned SHA in the client.

capabilities.title: Read exact subcategories/services for a caller-selected parent category
Search public provider summary for explicitly supplied service and optional region filters
capabilities.note: Returned profiles are public search summaries. A match is not a quote, availability guarantee, recommendation, or transaction.

capabilities.title: Collect a bounded number of cursor pages while retaining incomplete coverage
capabilities.note: Bounded collection. A provider omitted from one result is not considered inactive or closed.

capabilities.title: Read a public provider profile summary bound to an exact user and optional expected provider ID
capabilities.note: A path/provider match is public identity binding only; authenticated=false and ownerVerified=false.

capabilities.title: Read public profile content metadata without retaining media URLs
capabilities.note: Content rows expose presence/type/sequence only; completeness is limited to the returned response.

capabilities.title: Read a bounded public portfolio page with incomplete-pagination semantics
capabilities.note: Single-page public portfolio metadata. The separate bounded collector handles observed cursor continuation and source-count reconciliation.

capabilities.title: Collect bounded public portfolio pages with cursor and source-count checks
capabilities.note: The 140.228 run returned 20 portfolio rows over 3 pages, matching source total 20 with hasNextPage=false. This is complete only for the selected public profile; cursor values and media URLs are omitted.

capabilities.title: Read one public review page with redacted text and no reviewer identity
capabilities.note: Normalized reviewText is redacted. The committed public proof projection retains review-text hashes and lengths only; reviewer identities and provider review IDs are omitted. The one-page reader does not verify later-page continuation.

capabilities.title: Collect bounded public review metadata pages with cursor continuation
capabilities.note: The 140.228 run returned 6 rows over 2 pages; source total was unknown and hasNextPage remained true, so collection is partial. Normalized reviewText is redacted; committed evidence stores hashes and lengths only, without reviewer identities or cursor values.

capabilities.title: Read a catalog-selected request questionnaire schema
capabilities.note: Conditional coverage can remain incomplete; form read does not dispatch a request.

capabilities.title: Read a bounded area-3 address option list for local questionnaire preparation
capabilities.note: The upstream response exposes no total or pagination; output remains incomplete.

capabilities.title: Prepare and validate a local request draft without sending it
capabilities.note: Local-only. An isolated hiring-UI capture observed answer IDs for one checkbox, date, and three-level address example; wireMappingVerified remains false because no POST body was accepted or read back. Auth, phone, account-details, terms, and privacy gates remain unverified.
capabilities.blocker: This operation does not submit a request, contact a provider, create a quote, or confirm server acceptance.

capabilities.title: Submit a genuine service request to a user-selected provider

sourceEvidence.title: First-party source candidates only; no request was replayed

capabilities.note: No request is submitted by request-prepare. A real target, user-authored payload, required verification, consent, and independent read-back are separate gates.
capabilities.blocker: No dispatch implementation or live proof. Synthetic/fabricated leads are prohibited.

capabilities.title: Record the normal Naver browser bootstrap and consent state
capabilities.note: Manual normal-browser Naver bootstrap only. Sanitized context: verification/soomgo-auth-2026-10-27/soomgo-auth-bootstrap-context.json. Required consent was approved; optional consent readbacks are false; name certification is unverified. This is not automated OAuth or refresh evidence.

capabilities.title: Read /api2/users/me and match the returned owner to the pinned session
capabilities.note: The Token-authenticated GET matched the owner pinned during manual Naver browser bootstrap; the anonymous control returned 401. Identity values are omitted. See verification/soomgo-auth-2026-10-27/manifest.json.

capabilities.title: Reuse the owner session from a separate process through the persistent credential store
capabilities.note: Two distinct fresh processes reused the same Windows DPAPI CurrentUser store and matched the pinned owner. No login/import was sent during reuse; automatic refresh remains unimplemented.

capabilities.title: Read the owner-bound opened request list
capabilities.note: The Bearer read with status=opened and limit=15 returned 200 and zero rows. Empty is a valid current result, not proof of future absence.

capabilities.title: Read the owner-bound closed and expired request list
capabilities.note: The Bearer read with status=closed,expired and limit=15 returned 200 and zero rows. Empty is a valid current result, not proof of future absence.

capabilities.title: Read the owner-bound customer chat list
capabilities.note: The Token read with role=customer returned 200 and zero results on the first page. Pagination was not followed; complete=false.

capabilities.title: Read owner-bound sent-quote lists and quote details

sourceEvidence.title: Current or first-party source route only; no protected replay or write was performed

capabilities.note: Current Next source exposes provider quote list/detail routes using APICore Token. No authenticated replay of these routes is present in the 2026-10-27 manifest.
capabilities.blocker: Authenticated owner binding, current response schema, filters, and pagination need direct replay before implementation.

capabilities.title: Read an individual chat and paginated message history

sourceEvidence.title: Current or first-party source route only; no protected replay or write was performed

capabilities.note: Current Next source exposes chat detail/message read routes, but the 2026-10-27 manifest contains no authenticated detail or message-item replay.
capabilities.blocker: No authenticated detail/message replay or verified message-item schema is recorded.

capabilities.title: Send a genuine provider quote to a user-selected request
capabilities.note: No exact quote-send route or accepted write schema has been established.
capabilities.blocker: No genuine target/payload exists; do not invent a quote or submit a synthetic business action.

capabilities.title: Send a genuine message to a user-selected chat recipient
capabilities.note: The implementation supports read-only customer chat-list access only; message read/write contracts are incomplete.
capabilities.blocker: No genuine chat recipient or user-authored message is available; no message write is implemented or authorized.
